Text: Stacks Grant: Week 2 Update

Milestone 1 is in! There's now 11 @Stacks orgs live on Vibewatch with dashboards up and running 💚

New since last week: @bitflow, @aibtcdev, @boom_wallet, @StacksEndowment, and @sfdstacks 🫡

ICYMI: The entire @Stacks ecosystem gets a FREE 3-month Vibewatch subscription, paid for by the grant. @ALEXLabBTC, @xverse, @LeatherBTC, @GraniteBTC, @trygamma, @ArkadikoFinance, @one_bns, @TheFastPool... your seats are waiting 👀

Next up: Enough Stacks partners have signed on that we can now start working on the Stacks Ecosystem Sentiment Index, covering the whole cohort. We'll continue to onboard more Stacks partners in the meantime. We have a busy August ahead of us! Thank you for the support!
